name: @payswap/onchain-extensions
description: Onchain extension-pack vocabulary (Work Order P5-W2, lane R3-W2): the versioned, declarative descriptor language for onchain venue families — DEX, bridge, off-ramp, liquidity, lending/staking and intent-protocol packs. A pack is DATA, never execution: it declares what a venue family offers (capability surface), how it is addressed (canonical pack/protocol/chain identities) and which constraints/assumptions it carries — it can never authorize (constraints carry authorityCarrier: false by literal type; certification status is never carried). Packs compose as versioned sub-pack references resolved by the declarative registry. Zero runtime dependencies; devDependencies are exactly the toolchain (typescript + vitest); the onchain-domain/capability contract shapes are LOCAL STRUCTURAL PINS (leaf-in-flight law — the TL wires the types at integration).
